subtopic: Diversification Across and Within Asset Classes
source_evidence: But a mutual fund or ETF won’t necessarily provide diversification, especially if it is narrowly focused (such as on one industry sector).
question: Misconception: Owning one mutual fund automatically means your investments are diversified.
answer: A mutual fund does not necessarily provide diversification, especially if it focuses narrowly on one industry sector. Diversification can involve spreading investments across different asset classes and across different investments or sectors within each class. Check a fund’s holdings to see whether they differ from your other investments.
